name: gonic
description: A light music server for Subsonic apps on your phone and desktop

paths.name: Data
paths.description: gonic's database (library, users, play counts) and playlists. Back it up.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Transcoded audio and cover art. Safe to empty.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Your music, read only. Point it at the folder with your albums; /mnt/cache/media/Music by default.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: gonic admin page and Subsonic API, published on host as 7005

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: GONIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Leave blank and IceStore makes an admin password on first start and shows it in the app's log under CREDENTIALS. Type one here to use your own; it is set again on every start.

variables.name: GONIC_SCAN_INTERVAL
variables.description: Minutes between scans for new music. Leave blank to scan only by hand.

variables.name: GONIC_SCAN_AT_START_ENABLED
variables.description: true scans your music each time gonic starts.
